# jplot

Jplot tracks expvar-like (JSON) metrics and plot their evolution over time right into your iTerm2, Kitty terminal, or terminals with DRCS Sixel Graphics support.

![](doc/demo.gif)

Above capture is jplot monitoring a Go service's expvar:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

By default, jplot uses the full size of the terminal, but it is possible to limit the render to a few rows:

![](doc/rows.gif)

## Install

Using homebrew:

```
brew install rs/tap/jplot
```

This tool works with [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com), [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/), [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/), or terminals that support DRCS Sixel Graphics.

## Usage

Given the following JSON output:

```
{
    "mem": {
        "Heap": 1234,
        "Sys": 4321,
        "Stack": 203
    },
    "cpu": {
        "STime": 123,
        "UTime":1234
    },
    "Threads": 2
}
```

You can graph the number of thread over time:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars Threads
```

![](doc/single.png)

Or create a graph with both Utime and Stime growth rate on the same axis by using `+` between two field paths:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars counter:cpu.STime+counter:cpu.UTime
```

Note: the `counter:` prefix instructs jplot to compute the difference between the values instead of showing their absolute value.

![](doc/dual.png)


Or create several graphs by providing groups of fields as separate arguments; each argument creates a new graph:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars mem.Heap+mem.Sys+mem.Stack counter:cpu.STime+cpu.UTime Threads
```

![](doc/all.png)

### Spec Syntax

Each positional arguments given to jplot create a stacked graph with the specified values. To reference the values, use JSON query syntax. Several value paths can be referenced for the same graph by using the `+` character to separate them.

In addition, each value path can be prefixed with options separated from the path by a column. Several options can be used for the same command by separating them with a comma like so: `option1,option2:value.path`.

Supported options are:
* `counter`: Computes the difference with the last value. The value must increase monotonically.
* `marker`: When the value is none-zero, a vertical line is drawn.

## Recipes

### Memstats

Here is an example command to graph a Go program memstats:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

![](doc/memstats.png)

### Vegeta

With the help of jaggr, jplot can be used to integrate vegeta as follow:

```
echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | \
    vegeta attack -rate 5000 -workers 100 -duration 10m | vegeta dump | \
    jaggr @count=rps \
          hist\[100,200,300,400,500\]:code \
          p25,p50,p95:latency \
          sum:bytes_in \
          sum:bytes_out | \
    jplot rps+code.hist.100+code.hist.200+code.hist.300+code.hist.400+code.hist.500 \
          latency.p95+latency.p50+latency.p25 \
          bytes_in.sum+bytes_out.sum
```

![](doc/vegeta.gif)

### Supported Terminals

* [xterm](http://invisible-island.net/xterm/)
* [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com/) on OSX
* [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [mintty](https://mintty.github.io/) on UNIX OSs via SSH
* [mlterm](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mlterm/) on Linux and Windows
* [RLogin](http://nanno.dip.jp/softlib/man/rlogin/) on Windows
* [yaft](http://uobikiemukot.github.io/yaft/) on Linux console
* [yaft-android](https://github.com/uobikiemukot/yaft-android) on Android
* [Tanasinn](http://saitoha.github.io/tanasinn/) on Firefox/Thunderbird

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, select

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    script = os.environ.get('FEED','')
    cols = int(os.environ.get('COLS','200')); rows=int(os.environ.get('ROWS','50'))
    term = os.environ.get('NEWWTERM','xterm-256color')
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master)
        os.setsid(slave)
        os.dup2(slave, 0); os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        env.pop('FEED', None)
        devnull = os.open('/dev/null', os.O_RDWR)
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave)
    out = []
    stop = [False]
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            out.append(d)
    t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); t.start()
    time.sleep(0.6)
    lines = [l for l in script.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    for l in lines:
        try: os.write(master, l.encode()+b'\n')
        except OSError: break
        time.sleep(0.35)
    time.sleep(1.2)
    stop[0]=True
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass
    time.sleep(0.2)
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(out))
main()

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, select, subprocess

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    script = os.environ.get('FEED','')
    cols = int(os.environ.get('COLS','200')); rows=int(os.environ.get('ROWS','50'))
    term = os.environ.get('NEWWTERM','xterm-256color')
    resp = os.environ.get('RESP','')
    stdin_mode = os.environ.get('STDINMODE','pty')  # pty | fifo
    reply_delay = float(os.environ.get('RD','0.05'))
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        if stdin_mode == 'pty':
            os.dup2(slave, 0)
        else:
            os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        env.pop('FEED', None); env.pop('RESP', None)
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    out = []
    stop = [False]
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            out.append(d)
            if resp and b'\x1b[c' in d:
                os.write(master, resp.encode())
    t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); t.start()
    time.sleep(0.6)
    lines = [l for l in script.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if stdin_mode == 'pty':
        for l in lines:
            try: os.write(master, l.encode()+b'\n')
            except OSError: break
            time.sleep(0.35)
    else:
        for l in lines:
            try: os.write(extra_w, l.encode()+b'\n')
            except OSError: break
            time.sleep(0.35)
    time.sleep(1.2)
    stop[0]=True
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass
    time.sleep(0.2)
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(out))
main()

import subprocess, sys, time, os, signal

def tm(*args, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(['tmux']+args, capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)

def run(name, resp_bytes, jlines, outname, wait=0.7, extra_env='', args='a'):
    subprocess.run(['tmux','kill-server'], capture_output=True)
    time.sleep(0.3)
    tm('new-session','-d','-x','200','-y','50','-s',name,'bash')
    time.sleep(0.5)
    tm('pipe-pane','-t',name,'-o','cat > /tmp/'+outname+'.log')
    cmd = f"cd /workspace; rm -f /tmp/ff; mkfifo /tmp/ff; (sleep 0.6; printf %s \"{jlines}\" > /tmp/ff) & {extra_env} TERM=xterm-256color ./executable {args} < /tmp/ff; echo RC_DONE=$?"
    tm('send-keys','-t',name, cmd, 'Enter')
    time.sleep(wait)
    # send response to pty input
    for rb in resp_bytes:
        tm('send-keys','-t',name,'-l', rb)
        time.sleep(0.3)
    time.sleep(2.0)
    print("=== raw ===")
    sys.stdout.write(subprocess.run(['cat','-v','/tmp/'+outname+'.log'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
    print("=== pane ===")
    print(tm('capture-pane','-t',name,'-p').stdout)
    return

    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'kitty':

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, select

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    script = os.environ.get('FEED','')
    cols = int(os.environ.get('COLS','200')); rows=int(os.environ.get('ROWS','50'))
    term = os.environ.get('NEWWTERM','xterm-256color')
    kresp = os.environ.get('KRESP','')
    daresp = os.environ.get('DARESP','')
    stdin_mode = os.environ.get('STDINMODE','fifo')
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        if stdin_mode == 'pty':
            os.dup2(slave, 0)
        else:
            os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        env.pop('FEED', None); env.pop('KRESP', None); env.pop('DARESP', None)
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    out = []
    stop = [False]
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            out.append(d)
            if kresp and b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d:
                os.write(master, kresp.encode())
            elif daresp and b'\x1b[c' in d:
                os.write(master, daresp.encode())
    t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); t.start()
    time.sleep(0.6)
    lines = [l for l in script.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    w = extra_w if stdin_mode=='fifo' else master
    for l in lines:
        try: os.write(w, l.encode()+b'\n')
        except OSError: break
        time.sleep(0.3)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    stop[0]=True
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass
    time.sleep(0.2)
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(out))
main()

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, select

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    script = os.environ.get('FEED','')
    cols = int(os.environ.get('COLS','200')); rows=int(os.environ.get('ROWS','50'))
    term = os.environ.get('NEWWTERM','xterm-256color')
    kresp = os.environ.get('KRESP','')
    daresp = os.environ.get('DARESP','')
    stdin_mode = os.environ.get('STDINMODE','fifo')
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        if stdin_mode == 'pty':
            os.dup2(slave, 0)
        else:
            os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        env.pop('FEED', None); env.pop('KRESP', None); env.pop('DARESP', None)
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    out = []
    stop = [False]
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            out.append(d)
            if kresp and b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d:
                os.write(master, kresp.encode())
            elif daresp and b'\x1b[c' in d:
                os.write(master, daresp.encode())
    t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); t.start()
    time.sleep(0.6)
    lines = [l for l in script.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    w = extra_w if stdin_mode=='fifo' else master
    for l in lines:
        try: os.write(w, l.encode()+b'\n')
        except OSError: break
        time.sleep(0.3)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    stop[0]=True
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass
    time.sleep(0.2)
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(out))
main()
EOF

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, select

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]

    cols = int(os.environ.get('COLS','200')); rows=int(os.environ.get('ROWS','50'))

    kresp = os.environ.get('KRESP','')

    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()

        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)

    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    out = []
    stop = [False]
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:

            except OSError:

    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass

    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(out))
main()

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/h5.py
import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    cols = int(os.environ.get('COLS','200')); rows=int(os.environ.get('ROWS','50'))
    term = os.environ.get('NEWWTERM','xterm-256color')
    stdin_mode = os.environ.get('STDINMODE','fifo')
    # FEED entries: 'M:<bytes>' for master, 'S:<bytes>' for stdin, with delays via 'D:<sec>'
    steps = os.environ.get('STEPS','')
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        if stdin_mode == 'pty':
            os.dup2(slave, 0)
        else:
            os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        for k in ('STEPS','COLS','ROWS','NEWTERM','STDINMODE'):
            env.pop(k, None)
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    out = []
    stop = [False]
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            out.append(d)
    t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); t.start()
    time.sleep(0.5)
    for step in steps.split('|'):
        if not step: continue
        k, _, v = step.partition(':')
        if k == 'D':
            time.sleep(float(v))
        elif k == 'M':
            os.write(master, v.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1'))
        elif k == 'S':
            os.write(extra_w, v.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1'))
    time.sleep(1.0)
    stop[0]=True
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass
    time.sleep(0.2)
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(out))
main()
EOF

import subprocess, sys, time, os

def tm(*args, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(['tmux']+list(args), capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/h6.py
import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, json

def unesc(s):
    return s.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1')

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    cfg = json.loads(os.environ.get('CFG','{}'))
    rows = cfg.get('rows', 50); cols = cfg.get('cols', 200)
    term = cfg.get('term', 'xterm-256color')
    kdelay = cfg.get('kdelay')     # seconds after kitty query observed, or None
    dadelay = cfg.get('dadelay')
    pixdelay = cfg.get('pixdelay')
    kresp = unesc(cfg.get('kresp', '\\x1b_Gi=1;OK\\x1b\\\\'))
    daresp = unesc(cfg.get('daresp', '\\x1b[?62;4c'))
    pixresp = unesc(cfg.get('pixresp', '\\x1b[4;1000;1600t'))
    feed = cfg.get('feed', [('0.3', '{"a":3}'), ('0.6', '{"a":5}')])
    dur = cfg.get('dur', 3.0)
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    events = []
    stop = [False]
    t0 = time.time()
    def later(d, fn):
        def runf():
            time.sleep(d); fn()
        threading.Thread(target=runf, daemon=True).start()
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'OUT', d))
            if b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d and kdelay is not None:
                later(kdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-K',kresp)), os.write(master, kresp)))
            if b'\x1b[c' in d and dadelay is not None:
                later(dadelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-DA',daresp)), os.write(master, daresp)))
            if b'\x1b[14t' in d and pixdelay is not None:
                later(pixdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-PIX',pixresp)), os.write(master, pixresp)))
    th = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); th.start()
    for ts, data in feed:
        d = float(ts)
        def f(data=data):
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'IN-DATA', data))
            os.write(extra_w, data.encode()+b'\n')
        later(d, f)
    def ender():
        time.sleep(dur); stop[0]=True
        try: os.close(master)
        except: pass
        try: os.close(extra_w)
        except: pass
    threading.Thread(target=ender, daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(dur+0.5)
    for e in events:
        print('%.3f %s %r' % (e[0], e[1], e[2]))
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
main()
EOF

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, json

def unesc(s):
    return s.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1')

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    cfg = json.loads(os.environ.get('CFG','{}'))
    rows = cfg.get('rows', 50); cols = cfg.get('cols', 200)
    term = cfg.get('term', 'xterm-256color')
    kdelay = cfg.get('kdelay')     # seconds after kitty query observed, or None
    dadelay = cfg.get('dadelay')
    pixdelay = cfg.get('pixdelay')
    kresp = unesc(cfg.get('kresp', '\\x1b_Gi=1;OK\\x1b\\\\'))
    daresp = unesc(cfg.get('daresp', '\\x1b[?62;4c'))
    pixresp = unesc(cfg.get('pixresp', '\\x1b[4;1000;1600t'))
    feed = cfg.get('feed', [('0.3', '{"a":3}'), ('0.6', '{"a":5}')])
    dur = cfg.get('dur', 3.0)
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    events = []
    stop = [False]
    t0 = time.time()
    def later(d, fn):
        def runf():
            time.sleep(d); fn()
        threading.Thread(target=runf, daemon=True).start()
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'OUT', d))
            if b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d and kdelay is not None:
                later(kdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-K',kresp)), os.write(master, kresp)))
            if b'\x1b[c' in d and dadelay is not None:
                later(dadelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-DA',daresp)), os.write(master, daresp)))
            if b'\x1b[14t' in d and pixdelay is not None:
                later(pixdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-PIX',pixresp)), os.write(master, pixresp)))
    th = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True); th.start()
    for ts, data in feed:
        d = float(ts)
        def f(data=data):
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'IN-DATA', data))
            os.write(extra_w, data.encode()+b'\n')
        later(d, f)
    def ender():
        time.sleep(dur); stop[0]=True
        try: os.close(master)
        except: pass
        try: os.close(extra_w)
        except: pass
    threading.Thread(target=ender, daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(dur+0.5)
    for e in events:
        print('%.3f %s %r' % (e[0], e[1], e[2]))
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass
main()
EOF

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, json
exec(open('/tmp/h7.py').read().split('def main()')[0])
def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    cfg = json.loads(os.environ.get('CFG','{}'))
    rows = cfg.get('rows', 50); cols = cfg.get('cols', 200)
    term = cfg.get('term', 'xterm-256color')
    env = cfg.get('env', {})
    kdelay = cfg.get('kdelay'); dadelay = cfg.get('dadelay'); pixdelay = cfg.get('pixdelay')
    kresp = unesc(cfg.get('kresp', '\\x1b_Gi=1;OK\\x1b\\\\'))
    daresp = unesc(cfg.get('daresp', '\\x1b[?62;4c'))
    pixresp = unesc(cfg.get('pixresp', '\\x1b[4;1000;1600t'))
    feed = cfg.get('feed', [('0.3', '{"a":3}'), ('0.6', '{"a":5}')])
    dur = cfg.get('dur', 3.0)
    verbose = cfg.get('verbose', 1)
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        e = dict(os.environ); e['TERM'] = term
        for k,v in env.items():
            if v is None: e.pop(k, None)
            else: e[k]=v
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, e)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    events=[]; stop=[False]; t0=time.time()
    def later(d, fn):
        threading.Thread(target=lambda: (time.sleep(d), fn()), daemon=True).start()
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try: d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError: return
            if not d: return
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'OUT-BIG' if len(d)>200 else 'OUT', d[:100] if len(d)>200 else d, len(d)))
            if b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d and kdelay is not None:
                later(kdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-K',kresp,0)), os.write(master,kresp)))
            if b'\x1b[c' in d and dadelay is not None:
                later(dadelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-DA',daresp,0)), os.write(master,daresp)))
            if b'\x1b[14t' in d and pixdelay is not None:
                later(pixdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-PIX',pixresp,0)), os.write(master,pixresp)))
    threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True).start()
    for ts, data in feed:
        later(float(ts), lambda data=data: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-DATA',data,0)), os.write(extra_w,(data+'\n').encode())))
    threading.Thread(target=lambda: (time.sleep(dur), stop.__setitem__(0,True)), daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(dur+0.7)
    os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
    if verbose:
        for e in events:
            print('%.3f %s len=%d %r' % (e[0], e[1], e[3], e[2]))
    try: os.kill(pid,9)
    except: pass
main()

    if verbose:
        for e in events:

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
import an
def show(path, x0,y0,x1,y1, invert=False):
    w,h,rows = an.load(path)
    chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
    for y in range(y0,y1):
        line=''
        for x in range(x0,x1):
            r=rows[y][x*4:x*4+4]
            a=r[3]/255.0
            b=(r[0]+r[1]+r[2])/3/255.0
            v = a*b
            if invert: v=1-v
            line += chars[min(9,int(v*10))]
        print('%4d %s' % (y, line))
if __name__=='__main__':
    show(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]),int(sys.argv[3]),int(sys.argv[4]),int(sys.argv[5]))

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, json

def unesc(s):
    return s.replace('\\e', chr(27)).replace('\\\\', chr(92)).encode('latin1')

def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    cfg = json.loads(os.environ.get('CFG','{}'))
    rows = cfg.get('rows', 50); cols = cfg.get('cols', 200)
    term = cfg.get('term', 'xterm-256color')
    kdelay = cfg.get('kdelay')
    dadelay = cfg.get('dadelay')
    pixdelay = cfg.get('pixdelay')
    kresp = unesc(cfg.get('kresp', '\\x1b_Gi=1;OK\\x1b\\\\'))
    daresp = unesc(cfg.get('daresp', '\\x1b[?62;4c'))
    pixresp = unesc(cfg.get('pixresp', '\\x1b[4;1000;1600t'))
    feed = cfg.get('feed', [('0.3', '{"a":3}'), ('0.6', '{"a":5}')])
    dur = cfg.get('dur', 3.0)
    outfile = cfg.get('out')
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM'] = term
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    events = []
    stop = [False]
    t0 = time.time()
    def later(d, fn):
        def runf():
            time.sleep(d); fn()
        threading.Thread(target=runf, daemon=True).start()
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not d: return
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'OUT', d))
            if b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d and kdelay is not None:
                later(kdelay, lambda: (events.append((time.time()-t0,'IN-K',kresp)), os.write(master, kresp)))

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from go1 import go

for g in groups:
    xs=[min(p[0] for p in c) for c in g]
    print("label at x=%d..%d, parts=%d" % (min(xs), max(p[0] for p in g), len(g)))
PY

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
import an, importlib, collections
d = importlib.import_module('decode')
def groups(png, x0=0, x1=None, y0=962, y1=977, thr=60, gap=4):

    if x1 is None: x1=w
    cs = d.comps_fn(rows,w,h,x0,x1,y0,y1,thr)
    cs.sort(key=lambda c: min(p[0] for p in c))
    out=[]; cur=[cs[0]]
    for c in cs[1:]:

def bm(c, ytop=None):
    xs=[p[0] for p in c]; ys=[p[1] for p in c]

    s=set(c)
    return tuple(''.join('#' if (x,y) in s else '.' for x in range(x0,x1+1)) for y in range(y0,y1+1)), (x0,y0)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from ocr import *
import an
w,h,rows = an.load('doc/single.png')

PY

cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/dec5.py <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from ocr2 import *
import an
def decode_labels(png, x0r, x1r, y0r=0, y1r=None, thresh=60, minx=None, tol=2):
    rows, tpl, _ = build_templates('/tmp/g3.png')
    w,h,_ = an.load(png)
    if y1r is None: y1r=h
    cs = d.comps_fn(rows,w,h,x0r,x1r,y0r,y1r,thresh)
    if minx: cs=[c for c in cs if x0(c)>=minx]
    cs.sort(key=y0)
    clusters=[]; cur=[cs[0]]
    for c in cs[1:]:
        if y0(c)-y0(cur[-1])<=tol: cur.append(c)
        else: clusters.append(cur); cur=[c]
    clusters.append(cur)
    res=[]
    for cl in clusters:
        cl.sort(key=x0)
        s=''
        for c in cl:
            ch,v = classify(c, tpl)
            s += ch if ch else '?'
        res.append((y0(cl[0]), y1(cl[0]), s, [x0(c) for c in cl]))
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    for r in decode_labels(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), minx=int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else None):
        print(r)
PY

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from ocr2 import *
import an
def region(png, x0r, x1r, y0r, y1r, thr=60):
    rows, tpl, _ = build_templates('/tmp/g3.png')
    w,h,_ = an.load(png)
    cs = d.comps_fn(rows,w,h,x0r,x1r,y0r,y1r,thr)
    cs.sort(key=x0)
    res=[]
    for c in cs:
        ch,v = classify(c, tpl)
        res.append((x0(c),x1(c),y0(c),y1(c),ch,round(v,2)))
    return res
PY

    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()

        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)

    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r)
    events = []; stop=[False]; t0=time.time()
    def later(d, fn):
        threading.Thread(target=lambda: (time.sleep(d), fn()), daemon=True).start()

            if b'\x1b[14t' in d and pixdelay is not None:
                later(pixdelay, lambda: os.write(master, pixresp))
    threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True).start()
    for ts, data in feed:

    def ender():
        time.sleep(dur)
        try: os.close(extra_w)   # EOF on stdin
        except: pass
        time.sleep(cfg.get('tail', 1.5))
        stop[0]=True
        try: os.close(master)
        except: pass
    threading.Thread(target=ender, daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(dur+cfg.get('tail',1.5)+0.6)
    with open(outfile,'wb') as fh:
        for e in events:
            if e[1]=='OUT': fh.write(e[2])
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass

import os, pty, sys, time, fcntl, termios, struct, threading, json
exec(open('/tmp/h7.py').read().split('def main()')[0])
def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    cfg = json.loads(os.environ.get('CFG','{}'))
    rows = cfg.get('rows', 50); cols = cfg.get('cols', 200)
    term = cfg.get('term', 'xterm-256color')
    kdelay = cfg.get('kdelay'); dadelay = cfg.get('dadelay'); pixdelay = cfg.get('pixdelay')
    kresp = unesc(cfg.get('kresp', '\\e_Gi=1;OK\\e\\'))
    daresp = unesc(cfg.get('daresp', '\\e[?62;1;2c'))
    pixresp = unesc(cfg.get('pixresp', '\\e[4;1000;1600t'))
    feed = cfg.get('feed', [])
    dur = cfg.get('dur', 3.0)
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', rows, cols, 0, 0))
    extra_r, extra_w = os.pipe()
    err_r, err_w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master); os.close(extra_w); os.close(err_r)
        os.setsid()
        os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(err_w, 2)
        os.dup2(extra_r, 0)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        env = dict(os.environ); env['TERM'] = term
        os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
    os.close(slave); os.close(extra_r); os.close(err_w)
    events = []; stop=[False]; t0=time.time()
    errs=[]
    def later(d, fn):
        threading.Thread(target=lambda: (time.sleep(d), fn()), daemon=True).start()
    def reader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try: d = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError: return
            if not d: return
            events.append((time.time()-t0, 'OUT', d))
            if b'\x1b_Gi=1,a=q' in d and kdelay is not None:
                later(kdelay, lambda: os.write(master, kresp))
            if b'\x1b[c' in d and dadelay is not None:
                later(dadelay, lambda: os.write(master, daresp))
            if b'\x1b[14t' in d and pixdelay is not None:
                later(pixdelay, lambda: os.write(master, pixresp))
    def errreader():
        while not stop[0]:
            try: d = os.read(err_r, 65536)
            except OSError: return
            if not d: return
            errs.append(d)
    threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=errreader, daemon=True).start()
    for ts, data in feed:
        later(float(ts), lambda data=data: os.write(extra_w, (data+'\n').encode()))
    def ender():
        time.sleep(dur)
        try: os.close(extra_w)
        except: pass
        time.sleep(0.5)
        stop[0]=True
        try: os.close(master)
        except: pass
        try: os.close(err_r)
        except: pass
    threading.Thread(target=ender, daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(dur+1.1)
    for e in events:
        if e[1]=='OUT': sys.stdout.buffer.write(e[2])
    sys.stdout.flush()
    sys.stderr.write("STDERR: %r\n" % (b''.join(errs).decode('latin1'),))
    try:
        _, status = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
        print("EXIT: %r" % (status,))
    except Exception as e: print("exit?", e)
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except: pass

#!/bin/sh
set -e

export GOFLAGS=${GOFLAGS:-}

# jplot reimplementation — status report

## What was reverse engineered (from black-box testing of ./executable)

* CLI: flags `-interval` (default 1s), `-rows`, `-steps` (default 100), `-url`;
  positional FIELD_SPECs (`[opt[,opt]:]path`, options `counter`,`marker`).
  Go `flag` semantics: parsing stops at the first positional argument, bad
  flag values exit with code 2.
* Help text: exact copy stored in `helpText` (see src/main.go).
* Error strings (all printed as `fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "jplot: ", err)` — note
  the two spaces produced by Fprintln):
  * `iTerm2, Kitty, or DRCS Sixel graphics required`
  * `neither --url nor stdin is provided` (when stdin is a tty and no -url)
  * `Data source error:  input error: <json or http error>`
  * `Data source error:  cannot get <path>: <part> does not exist.`
  * `Data source error:  cannot get <path>: <part> is not an object. map[]`
  * `Data source error:  invalid type <path>: <Go type>` (`%T`)
  * `Cannot get window size:  cannot get terminal cell size`
* Terminal detection: `TERM_PROGRAM == "iTerm.app"` ⇒ iTerm2 (no queries).
  Otherwise a kitty graphics query `\x1b_Gi=1,a=q,t=d,f=24\x1b\\` is written and
  one response is read from /dev/tty (blocking, no timeout — this is what the
  original does); any APC answer selects kitty.  Otherwise `\x1b[c` is sent and
  the answer decides sixel support: answer must be `\x1b[?1;2;4c` exactly, or
  have first field 62..65 and contain field `4` (the trailing `c` stays attached
  to the last field).  Sixel wins over kitty.
* Cell size: kitty/sixel send `\x1b[14t` once (first frame only) and parse
  `\x1b[4;<h>;<w>t`; iTerm2 sends `\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07` every frame.
  cellW = W/(cols-1), cellH = H/(rows-1); image is cellW*(cols-1) × cellH*(rows-1).
  With `-rows N` the height is N*(H/rows-1) instead.
* Frame escape sequence: `\x1b[?25l`, rows×`\r\n`, `\x1b[<rows>A`, `\x1b[s`,
  (first frame) size query, image, [`\x1b_Ga=d,d=i,i=<prev>,q=2\x1b\\`],
  `\x1b[u`; image ids alternate 2,1,2,1… (previous one deleted after drawing).
  On EOF: `\x1b[?25h`, `\x1b[<rows>B`, `\r\n`, exit 0.  Kitty images are
  `f=100` (PNG) base64 in a single APC; sixel uses a raw DCS sixel bitmap.
* Timing: after detection a ticker with `-interval` starts; the first tick is
  one interval later.  Data is read from stdin/url continuously; with -url the
  URL is polled once per interval.
* Layout (default 200x50 terminal, 8x20 cells): plot area x≈13…imgW-51,
  y≈10…imgH-27; two vertical grey (180,180,180 @128) axis lines, 30 x ticks
  (labels `0.00…1.00`, %.2f of the relative position, centred on ticks,
  baseline imgH-6), 29 y ticks (labels are i*max/28, grey), legend box
  (black @100) at top-left with `name:value` and a colour swatch.
  Series colours: (0,116,217), (217,101,0), (17,207,194), (217,0,116),
  (0,217,210), (0,217,101) …; area fill alpha 20, line alpha 255.
  Samples occupy the right-most N positions of the `steps` grid.

## Not finished / known gaps

* Text glyphs are drawn with a small hand-written stroke font, so the rendered
  labels/legend do not match the original bitmap exactly (the original uses an
  embedded TTF with sub-pixel positioning that could not be identified).
* `-steps 0` / negative `-rows` make the original panic (exit 2); this build
  clamps them instead of panicking.
* sixel encoder in src/encode.go is only a stub skeleton (band/colour map is
  not filled in correctly) – sixel output is not yet correct.
* iTerm2 `Draw` argument list is a guess; not verified against a real iTerm2.
* URL mode error path (poll failure) exits 1 with the http error text – matches
  observed behaviour but is not thoroughly tested.
* Graph layout constants were measured for a 200x50 terminal only.
EOF
cd src && go build -o /tmp/jplot . && echo BUILD_OK; ls -la /tmp/jplot"}
